thread.title: These 10 companies have the best pay and benefits, according to Indeed

author: SVBJ staff
title: These 10 companies have the best pay and benefits, according to Indeed
text: By SVBJ staff Mar 1, 2018, 6:38am PST Money isn't everything, but for most employees, the numbers after the dollar sign on the front of their paychecks do matter quite a bit. Employee benefits also play a big role in defining what a great place to work is. With that in mind, job listing site Indeed tapped its database of 18 million employee reviews to find the top 15 U.S. employers , as ranked by compensation and benefits. The site took into account the most common benefits — health insurance, parental leave, stock options and company matching for retirement plans — that you might expect from top employers. But some of the companies on the list, like Apple (Nasdaq: AAPL), also offer perks like tuition reimbursement, generous employee discounts on its products and an on-campus gym and doctor's office. The company plans to roll out a network of health clinics for its employees and their families in Silicon Valley and Austin this year. Still, the list is not dominated by tech companies, as one might expect. In fact, only two of Silicon Valley's biggest names — Apple and chipmaker Intel Corp. (Nasdaq: INTC) — made Indeed's ranking. Both Apple and Intel offer fertility and family-planning related benefits: the iPhone maker pays for egg freezing for female employees while Intel, No. 12 on the list, offers fertility assistance as well as covering some adoption expenses. Intel employs around 20,000 employees in Hillsboro. The No. 1 company on Indeed's list is retailer Costco Wholesale Corp. (Nasdaq: COST). Its spot at the top of the list "demonstrates that despite all the gloomy headlines we see about the 'retail apocalypse' some companies in the sector are continuing to perform strongly and motivate employees," Indeed notes. In fact, the list is diverse across industries: Microsoft Corp. , Starbucks Corp., Kaiser Permanente, Capital One Financial Corp., Verizon Communications , FedEx Corp., General Motors , Boeing and AT&T all rank in the top 15. The "takeaway," according to Indeed: "Great pay and benefits are relative. A retail company’s average compensation package may not come close to the average compensation package of a software firm, but when an organization leads its industry, it can secure a place among the top organizations overall." — See Indeed's top 15 list and read more about its methodology here .
